leadership.name: Mr. Adesh Jain
leadership.title: Director (Production & Purchase)
leadership.bio: With over three decades of experience in the industrial and trading sectors, Mr. Adesh Jain began his professional journey at the age of 18, before completing his graduation from Kolkata University. Rising through the ranks, he progressed from a regular staff role to Director of his own company, gaining in-depth operational and strategic expertise. After retiring from that role at 45, he turned to entrepreneurship, trading ferrous and non-ferrous metals for over five years — hands-on experience in procurement, logistics and market dynamics that laid the foundation for what followed. He has managed complete iron and steel factory setups from land acquisition through to day-to-day operations, and now brings that experience to cable and conductor manufacturing, serving India's growing infrastructure and energy sectors.

leadership.name: Mr. Sumeet Kr Bansal
leadership.title: Director (Finance & Banking)
leadership.bio: With over 25 years of entrepreneurial experience, Mr. Sumeet Kr Bansal built a strong foundation in trading before moving into manufacturing. After graduating in 1996, he joined his family business, developing a deep understanding of sales, procurement and human resource management. His career has been marked by resilience, adaptability and a hands-on approach to leadership — forging supplier relationships, managing teams and steering through market volatility. He now brings that trading expertise to a renewed focus on manufacturing, building a forward-looking, quality-driven enterprise.
